messages:
Lina (Sales): SkyBridge (channel partner) asked for a 10-day joint POC. Must-haves: SAML SSO, static egress for IP allowlist, staging tenant in us-east, and a procurement-ready cost range. Can we scope?
Marco (Partner Ops): I can provision staging and chase PO/MSA. Need contact for finance + their SAML metadata. @skybridge-onboard please share.
skybridge-onboard (external): finance@skybridge.ai. attaching sb_poc_sec_q1.xlsx and SAML metadata now. Procurement timeline tight (want numbers this week).
Jules (Solutions): Quick sizing Qs: expected concurrent users? avg tokens? seq len? that'll drive model choice (open vs redwood).
Lina (Sales): They expect ~25 conc, avg 250 tokens in / 150 out, seq len ~1024. Prefer open models but okay to trial Redwood variants.
Priya (Sec): Security asks: completed questionnaire, SOC2 summary, SAML entityID + cert, IP allowlist (can be ranges), KMS notes, and >=90d audit logs. I can own the questionnaire.
Dev (SRE): For static egress we can either: 1) do Dedicated capacity (our static IP pool + SLO) or 2) connect into their VPC with customer NAT (they manage IPs). Dedicated is simpler for SLOs. Staging in us-east1 OK.
Jules (Solutions): Suggested POC config: - small Dedicated pool (or hosted if they accept no static IP) - model candidates: open-llama-13B-8bit or redwood-medium-quant - enable KV caching, token window 2048 - include fallback to hosted smaller model if Dedicated saturates
Marco (Partner Ops): I've created tenant stub id=st-sky-poc-2280 (region=us-east1). Will finish provisioning after PO/DPA.
skybridge-onboard (external): can provide 5 test users and SAML metadata now. Prefer single static egress IP if possible.
Dev (SRE): Single IP per egress -> Dedicated + NAT required. I'll draft infra checklist: firewall rules, ports, certs, monitoring hooks.
Jules (Solutions): Cost ballpark for 100k generated tokens/day (approx 3M/month) + 25 conc: hosted (quantized open) ~$6k-$12k/mo; Dedicated reserved pool with static IP + SLO ~$16k-$26k/mo. Mark as estimates pending final sizing.
Priya (Sec): I'll review sb_poc_sec_q1.xlsx today and add SOC2 excerpt + KMS integration notes.
Marco (Partner Ops): Owners: @Marco=tenant & contracts; @Jules=runbook & perf tests; @Priya=security review; @Dev=infra checklist & egress config. I'll update partner and ask for PO by EOD.
Lina (Sales): please @mention me when runbook + cost sheet + security answers are ready. SkyBridge said if we can confirm static IP plan + DPA in 3 business days they'll sign. Thanks team :thumbsup:
